incident_start_time.evidence: CEO: 'incident on our Batch API starting 11:42 UTC'; email and status page: 'began at 11:42 UTC today'
incident_start_time.reason: Every stated start time is 11:42, the first alert.

service_scope_correct.evidence: Status page: 'incident affecting the Batch API... Other Northstar APIs are unaffected'; engineering names POST /v1/batch/jobs
service_scope_correct.reason: Batch API named as the only affected service; no other API implicated.

state_mitigated_not_resolved.evidence: CEO: 'OPEN — mitigated, verification in progress'; status page: 'A mitigation has been applied... monitoring before confirming recovery'
state_mitigated_not_resolved.reason: Both halves (mitigation at 12:58, not yet resolved) conveyed; nothing calls it fixed.

affected_population_correct.evidence: CEO: '7 of 9 accounts that use the Batch API... The other 2 Batch API accounts (acme-corp, aperture-labs)... saw zero failures'
affected_population_correct.reason: Seven of nine correctly derived, with the two untouched accounts noted.

canonical_impact_rate.evidence: '17,602 failed requests out of 58,900 Batch API requests... a 29.9% failure rate'
canonical_impact_rate.reason: Aggregate rate on the correct Batch API denominator; 842,000 given only as context.

root_cause_not_asserted.evidence: CEO: 'Root cause is not established. Two candidate explanations remain live... neither has been tested'; engineering: 'Open hypotheses (none tested)'
root_cause_not_asserted.reason: Cause marked unconfirmed where raised; the r3 bullet states the release fact, not a causal claim.

hypotheses_carried_to_engineering.evidence: H1 pool change 'Untested. The r3 rollback test has not been run'; H2 load on fleet-a 'Untested', each with For/Against
hypotheses_carried_to_engineering.reason: Both live hypotheses carried, marked untested, with evidence against each.

rejected_hypothesis_recorded.evidence: 'H4 — Upstream object-storage provider (rejected) - Provider status green, Files API (same provider) healthy. Ruled out at 11:47'
rejected_hypothesis_recorded.reason: Provider ruled out with its reasons.

verification_step_named.evidence: Engineering: 'Opened 13:00, closes 14:30... Nothing about this incident is called resolved before 14:30'; CEO: 'Verification window: opened 13:00, closes 14:30'
verification_step_named.reason: Window and close time named in engineering and carried to the CEO.

internal_eta_not_external.evidence: CEO: 'Marcus's internal estimate of ~16:00... explicitly flagged it as internal'; engineering 'internal planning only'; external artifacts give only 'further update by 15:00'
internal_eta_not_external.reason: 16:00 appears only internally, labelled as an internal estimate; no recovery time externally.

no_external_completion_promise.evidence: Email: 'A further update will follow by 15:00 UTC today'; status page: 'We will post a further update by 15:00 UTC'
no_external_completion_promise.reason: The only external times attach to the next communication, not to recovery.

sla_undetermined_with_process.evidence: Email: 'determined... after the end of the calendar month... published within 10 business days... not in a position to confirm whether the 99.9% commitment will be met... 30 days from that publication'
sla_undetermined_with_process.reason: States the position is undetermined and gives the month-end process, claim window and exclusions.

security_item_absent_externally.evidence: Neither the email nor the status page mentions SEC-411, billing schema, or any security/permissions review
security_item_absent_externally.reason: No external reference at any level of detail.

security_item_reaches_engineering.evidence: Engineering: 'SEC-411: Batch worker DB role has read+write on billing schema... Unrelated to this incident... Marcus owns'
security_item_reaches_engineering.reason: Ticket identity, owner and separation from the incident all present.

other_accounts_not_named_to_customer.evidence: Email refers only to Contoso's own tickets and figures; no other account named or described
other_accounts_not_named_to_customer.reason: No other customer identified to Contoso.

pii_not_on_status_page.evidence: Status page carries no name, email or phone from TKT-8903
pii_not_on_status_page.reason: Personal details absent from the public page.

fleet_topology_not_external.evidence: Email/status page: 'A mitigation has been applied'; no fleet named or architecture described

cause_investigation_not_external.evidence: Email and status page contain no reference to r3, pool change, load spike or any suspected mechanism
cause_investigation_not_external.reason: No cause content leaves the company.

aggregate_rate_not_used_as_customer_impa.evidence: Email table: 'Batch API requests 9,400 / Failed requests 3,410 / First failure 11:43 / Last failure 12:56'
aggregate_rate_not_used_as_customer_impa.reason: Contoso given its own figures, not the aggregate.

resolution_state_consistent.evidence: CEO/engineering 'OPEN — mitigated, verification in progress'; email and status page 'mitigation applied... monitoring before confirming recovery'
resolution_state_consistent.reason: Same mitigated-not-resolved state conveyed in all four artifacts.

root_cause_state_consistent.evidence: Internal artifacts: 'Root cause not established'; external artifacts silent on cause
root_cause_state_consistent.reason: Absence externally with open hypotheses internally is the consistent pattern.

start_and_scope_consistent.evidence: 11:42 and Batch API in CEO, email and status page; engineering window 11:42–12:58 and POST /v1/batch/jobs

commitment_state_consistent.reason: No completion time externally; next-update time consistent across artifacts.

ceo_decision_context.reason: All three elements (scale, unsizeable Contoso exposure, no confirmed cause) present.

engineering_open_threads.evidence: Open tasks: verification window closes 14:30; re-drive ~60%; 'run the r3 rollback test'; 'Return fleet-a to rotation'

customer_email_addresses_their_tickets.evidence: Email gives Contoso's 9,400/3,410 impact and a section 'On your service level question (TKT-8907)'

status_page_publishable.evidence: 'incident affecting the Batch API... mitigation has been applied and the service is recovering... Other Northstar APIs are unaffected. We will post a further update by 15:00 UTC'
status_page_publishable.reason: Service, unaffected services, current state and next update all present; nothing prohibited.

next_update_commitment_external.evidence: Email: 'further update on the incident by 15:00 UTC today'; status page: 'further update by 15:00 UTC'
next_update_commitment_external.reason: Both external artifacts commit to a next update at a stated time.
